```{r}
species_color_leaf <- readRDS("C:/Users/Jiali/Documents/phenology-urban/data/raw/local_db/color_leaf.rds")

species_color_leaf <- species_color_leaf %>%
  mutate(alan = case_when(
    First_Yes_Year == 2011 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2012 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2013 ~ alan_2013,
    First_Yes_Year == 2014 ~ alan_2014,
    First_Yes_Year == 2015 ~ alan_2015,
    First_Yes_Year == 2016 ~ alan_2016

unique_alan <- species_color_leaf %>%
  group_by(geometry, First_Yes_Year) %>%
  summarize(alan_avg = mean(alan, na.rm = TRUE))
threshold <- quantile(unique_alan$alan_avg, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]

urban_acer_db <- filter(species_color_leaf, alan >= threshold) %>%
  filter(Genus  == "Acer") %>%
  mutate(MAT = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter + Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring + 
                  Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer + Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 8) %>%
  select("Genus", "Species", "MAT") %>%
  group_by(Genus, Species) %>% 
  summarise_if(is.numeric,list(mean = ~mean(.,na.rm=T), median = ~median(.,na.rm=T), 
                               q05=~quantile(., probs=c(0.05), na.rm = T),q95=~quantile(., probs=c(0.95),na.rm = T)))
```

```{r}
read_and_average_nc <- function(year, lat, lon) {
  tmin_file <- paste0(folder.raw, "tmin_annavg_", year, "_ncss.nc")
  tmax_file <- paste0(folder.raw, "tmax_annavg_", year, "_ncss.nc")
  tmin.nc <- terra::rast(tmin_file)
  tmax.nc <- terra::rast(tmax_file)
  usboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(us_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(tmax.nc,proj = T)))
  
  tmax <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmax.nc, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)),
                                    usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))
  tmin <- terra::project(terra::mask (terra::crop(tmin.nc, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)), 
                                    usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))
  
  tavg_ann <- (tmax[[1]] + tmin[[1]])/2
  point_value <- extract(tavg_ann, matrix(c(lon, lat), ncol = 2))
  
  return(point_value)
}

us_acer_db <- us_acer_db %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(MAT = read_and_average_nc(year, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude))
```

# drought stress

1. prepare drought-related variable from TerraClimate dataset

```{r}
folder.raw <- "~/lab-data/climate/TerraClimate/annual_drought_2024update/"
us_boundary <- sf::read_sf('~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/boundary/us_boundarydissolve.shp')
us_boundary <- st_set_crs(us_boundary, "EPSG:4326")
color_leaf <- readRDS("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/local_db/color_leaf.rds")

color_leaf_sm <- color_leaf

process_yearly_data <- function(color_leaf_sm, us_boundary, folder.raw, factor) {
  for (year in unique(color_leaf_sm$First_Yes_Year)) {
    file_path <- paste0(folder.raw, "TerraClimate_", factor, "_", year, ".nc")
    file <- terra::rast(file_path)
    usboun_reproj <- sf::st_transform(us_boundary, crs = sf::st_crs(terra::crs(file, proj = TRUE)))
    yearly_data <- terra::project(terra::mask(terra::crop(file, terra::ext(usboun_reproj)), usboun_reproj), terra::crs(us_boundary))
    spring_data_m <- (yearly_data[[3]] + yearly_data[[4]] + yearly_data[[5]]) / 3
    summer_data_m <- (yearly_data[[6]] + yearly_data[[7]] + yearly_data[[8]]) / 3
    fall_data_m <- (yearly_data[[9]] + yearly_data[[10]] + yearly_data[[11]]) / 3
    spring_color <- extract(spring_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    summer_color <- extract(summer_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    fall_color <- extract(fall_data_m, color_leaf_sm)
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(spring_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_spring_", year)))
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(summer_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_summer_", year)))
    color_leaf_sm <- cbind(color_leaf_sm, setNames(list(fall_color[,2]), paste0(factor, "_fall_", year)))
  }
  return(color_leaf_sm)
}

factors <- c("soil", "pet", "aet", "def")
for (factor in factors) {
  color_leaf_sm <- process_yearly_data(color_leaf_sm, us_boundary, folder.raw, factor)
}
folder.raw_vpd <- "~/lab-data/climate/TerraClimate/annual_2023_upadate/"
color_leaf_sm <- process_yearly_data(color_leaf_sm, us_boundary, folder.raw_vpd, "vpd")


get_value_for_year <- function(data, year, prefix, default_col = NA) {
  year_col <- paste0(prefix, year)
  if (year_col %in% names(data)) {
    return(data[[year_col]])
  } else if (!is.na(default_col)) {
    return(data[[default_col]])
  } else {
    return(NA_real_)
  }
}
color_leaf_sm_site <- color_leaf_sm %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    spring_sm = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "soil_spring_"),
    summer_sm = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "soil_summer_"),
    fall_sm = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "soil_fall_"),
    
    spring_aet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "aet_spring_"),
    summer_aet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "aet_summer_"),
    fall_aet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "aet_fall_"),
    
    spring_def = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "def_spring_"),
    summer_def = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "def_summer_"),
    fall_def = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "def_fall_"),
    
    spring_vpd = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "vpd_spring_"),
    summer_vpd = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "vpd_summer_"),
    fall_vpd = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "vpd_fall_"),
    
    spring_pet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "pet_spring_"),
    summer_pet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "pet_summer_"),
    fall_pet = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "pet_fall_"),
    alan = get_value_for_year(cur_data(), First_Yes_Year, "alan_", default_col = "alan_2012")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select("Site_ID","Genus","Species","First_Yes_Year","Tmin_Winter","Tmin_Spring","Tmin_Summer","Tmin_Fall","Tmax_Winter","Tmax_Spring","Tmax_Summer","Tmax_Fall","First_Yes_DOY","AGDD", "geometry", "spring_sm","summer_sm","fall_sm","spring_aet","summer_aet","fall_aet","spring_pet","summer_pet","fall_pet", "spring_vpd","summer_vpd","fall_vpd","spring_def","summer_def","fall_def","alan")

unique_alan <- color_leaf_sm_site %>%
  group_by(geometry, First_Yes_Year) %>%
  summarize(alan_avg = mean(alan, na.rm = TRUE))
threshold <- quantile(unique_alan$alan_avg, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)[[1]]

analyze_color_leaf <- filter(color_leaf_sm_site, alan >= threshold | alan == 0) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    alan >= threshold ~ "ALAN",
    alan == 0 ~ "No ALAN"
    )) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Winter = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Spring = (Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Summer = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer) / 2) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Fall = (Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 2)%>%
  mutate(Tavg_Year = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter + Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring+ Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer + Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 8)
```
